input.instruction: Complete the staff handoff for a water-damage intake. Disposition follows intake readiness; unknown cause is a review flag, not a missing prerequisite. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: There is water damage to my sofa after yesterday evening. I put flood on the web form because everything was wet.
Did water come in from outdoors or from a pipe inside the building?
I was away. I do not know. The building manager mentioned a pipe but has not inspected it.
Where was the sofa, who owns it, and how can the claim team contact you?
It is my sofa at 23 Fern Walk, Unit 5, Morrow, US. Email me at omar.hill@post.example. The damage happened October 7, 2026.
You can supply photos without deciding the source. Is there still an immediate danger?
No immediate danger now. I have not sent photos yet. Please record the cause as unknown instead of guessing flood or a burst pipe.

event_date.description: Reported loss date in ISO format.

reported_cause.description: unknown means no cause established; internal_pipe means reported sudden internal supply-pipe escape; surface_flood means reported rising surface floodwater.

property_owner.description: customer means customer claims sole ownership; roommate means solely another occupant; unresolved means ownership unclear.

contact_email.description: Customer contact email for the intake.

photos_status.description: pending means not yet supplied; received means present in authoritative attachment records.

intake_readiness.description: ready_with_cause_review means the core H12 inputs exist but cause needs review; incomplete means a core input is missing.
